utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still helping gather a few folks for Tess’s repair drive this Saturday at the front porch. If you’re free for a bit, I’d love to have you join us.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can be there at 10 a.m. on Saturday and help at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll be there around 10 on Saturday at the front porch. Do you want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just yourself and whatever tools you’re comfortable bringing, if any. I really appreciate it, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Tess. I’ll come by the front porch on Saturday and help for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Oren, thank you. I’ll put you down for Saturday at the front porch and make sure there’s work ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, 9 on Saturday at the front porch works for me. I’ll keep the setup simple so we can get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll be there at 9 and ready to help with the setup at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Around 10 on Saturday at the front porch works for me. Do you still need anything else covered?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should cover it for now, thank you. I’ll just confirm the last few details and we should be set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still lining up a few helpers for the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch. If you can lend a hand for a bit, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can help out for a bit this Saturday at the front porch if you still need me. Just tell me what time to show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, 10 a.m. works for me. I’ll be there on the front porch and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s wonderful, Sam, thank you. I’ll count on you at 10 on the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around 10 on Saturday at the front porch would be perfect. Even a bit of help will make a big difference, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: 9 on Saturday at the front porch still works for me, and I’ll help get the repair drive set up. Just let me know what you need me to bring.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
